articles.title: Nigel Farage’s Reform UK lands $97 million donations from two crypto billionaires in 24 hours
articles.snippet: The combined haul equals the largest individual political donations in U.K. history, sharply scaling up crypto industry backing.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI race to slow down. Musk and OpenAI's Altman agrees
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed on an unusual position: frontier AI development may need to slow as systems become capable of helping build their own successors.

articles.title: Ripple stablecoin chief sees $13 trillion corporate treasury opportunity for RLUSD
articles.snippet: Payments and capital markets are driving growth for Ripple's $2.4 billion digital dollar as it looks to bring RLUSD to Europe under MiCA, the firm's Jack McDonald said.

articles.title: Ditching bonds for bitcoin: How crypto can tackle the AI-heavy portfolio dilemma
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Suisse says rising AI investment, government debt and weakening stock-bond diversification strengthen the case for adding bitcoin to traditional portfolios.

articles.title: Staked ether should be seen as the benchmark of the decentralized economy
articles.snippet: The yield-generating asset has a special place in the digital asset investor’s portfolio, argues GlobalStake’s Ryan Haczynski.
